interruption: Dropbox source upload returned an unknown outcome; setup stopped with a pending path in its private journal.
limitations: These facts compare the preserved local interruption journal with the completed journal and registered source.
The pending-upload code downloads and hashes the existing file before continuing; it does not blindly repeat that upload.
This receipt is not an independent provider request trace and does not count every network request.
Private registration IDs, provider IDs, remote paths, credentials and URLs are omitted.
